text:
alex: Heads-up: we're seeing a p99 spike of 5xx/timeouts from edge-proxy -> hosted-infer in us-west2 since ~10:30 UTC. Support has two escalations open.

maria: seeing the same on dashboards, SLO alert fired (ingress_5xx_rate > 1%). Links: https://dashboards/redwood/ingress/us-west2 and https://dashboards/redwood/slo/ingress-5xx

joel: alerts-bot shows repeated 'ingress-probe' SLO burn, but probe vs real mismatch looks small. customers report real requests failing.

alex: quick triage steps I ran:
1) kibana query for 5xx from edge-proxy
```
service:edge-proxy AND env:prod AND region:us-west2 AND response_status:[500 TO 599]
| sort @timestamp desc | limit 50
```
2) traced a failing request -> no spans after ingress (trace gap).

kyle: can you paste a sample request id? I want to check worker logs + batcher.

alex: sample req id: req_0a9c4f3b. Logs show "prefetch: timeout after 8s" and then upstream 502 returned.

maria: that suggests prefetch/kvcache load. We rolled a prefetch concurrency bump yesterday for dedicated pools. Could be backpressure with continuous batching.

joel: repro curl from inside prod VPC (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -v
```
Response: 502, body: "upstream connection reset".

support-bot: Two tickets linked: #4351 (enterprise X) and #4410 (mid-market Y). Both show 10:30-10:45 UTC failure window.

kyle: checking model-serving pool metrics: model-small latency stable but model-large pool p99 increased and connection resets spiked. Batcher queue length also up.

alex: tracing gap - spans missing from runtime-to-infer. Likely our sampling or instrumentation dropped due to high error rate. Check jaeger/error logs for runtime sidecar.

maria: quick mitigation options:
- enable canary fallback route to model-small for hosted inference (reduce load)
- temporarily disable prefetch for high-traffic customers (config flag)
- scale up model-serving pool by 2 nodes in us-west2 (if capacity available)
Which do we want now?

joel: IMO fallback + disable prefetch for the two affected customers. I'll open a rollout on console: route fallback -> model-small and flag prefetch:false for customers X & Y.

alex: I'll run targeted log query for req_0a9c4f3b timeframe to gather counts and correlate with auth/billing errors. Query:
```
service:hosted-infer AND request_id:req_0a9c4f3b OR span.parent_id:req_0a9c4f3b | stats count() by outcome
```

kyle: noticed a small burst of auth token renewal failures from KMS around 10:29 which caused retry storms in client libs. Could be correlated. Linking KMS alerts: https://alerts/redwood/kms/renewal-fail

maria: ok, temporary plan executed: fallback routes enabled, prefetch disabled for flagged customers, infra-scaling started (+2 nodes). Observability: p50 improved immediately, p99 dropping slowly.

alex: follow-ups:
- joel to confirm rollout logs + close support tickets with mitigation notes (#4351, #4410)
- kyle to deep-dive model-serving batcher queue and prefetch implementation for race conditions
- maria to run full SLO postmort checklist if p99 doesn't fully recover in 30m

joel: will post status update to #support once I confirm customers see success. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: autoscale request submitted: scale_up us-west2 model-pool +2 nodes. Change id: asg-9876.

alerts-bot: SLO alert resolved (ingress_5xx_rate) at 10:43 UTC.

alex: thanks — keep thread updated if traces reappear or new error class shows up.

kyle: adding to backlog: run a smoke test harness (prefetch stress test) against staging to reproduce timeouts under sustained auth-retry load.

support-bot: tickets annotated with mitigation steps and logs. Closing in support queue pending customer confirmation.

maria: marking this triage as 'mitigated' for now, will escalate to postmortem if recurrence within 72h.
